algorithm.aggregate_digest: SHA-256 of the concatenated UTF-8 listing
algorithm.path_encoding: POSIX relative to worktree root, no leading ./

archive.what: Pinned zip identity used by scripts/ensure_rime_vendor.sh fetch
archive.note: This SHA-256 is of the downloaded zip archive, not of extracted files.

receipt.what: Local marker written after a successful fetch; verify() greps version= and sha256= against the manifest
receipt.note: verify() does not re-hash extracted xcframework payloads; a mutated .a can still pass verify if Info.plist lints, a .a exists, and receipt text matches.

extracted_bytes.what: F2 freeze of actual on-disk Vendor files (this manifest)
extracted_bytes.note: F2 execution must recompute this listing; drift stops the matrix. fetch remains unauthorized while verify PASS.

checks: each xcframework contains at least one .a
